d: Long, flowing deep purple hair with straight bangs and a small white hairclip on the left side. Narrow, almond-shaped eyes in a vibrant magenta shade, paired with a youthful, adolescent facial appearance. A slender build, wearing a white collared shirt with a light blue necktie, a dark grey open blazer with white trim, and a blue and teal plaid pleated skirt. Accessories include large blue and white headphones around the neck, pink lace-up sneakers with white soles, and a black skateboard case slung over the shoulder.
